svg.title: IDEA Core v0 selected technology stack overview
svg.desc: Browser and a Windows engineering PC use one React business interface. The Windows desktop hosts it through WebView2 in a narrow WPF shell and calls a separate per-user dotnet Workspace through an authenticated named pipe. Clients send protected control commands to the Java Spring Server. For Core v0 large file bytes, the Workspace uses a short-lived scoped grant to transfer directly through one configured Artifact Gateway and Vault location. A future multi-vault seam is shown as deferred and is not part of Core v0 runtime delivery. Gateway runtime and storage provider are not selected by this view.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Future multi-vault seam — DEFER / not delivered in Core v0
